message.content: According to the conversations shared, Jennifer expressed her desire to add some flexibility and balance work to Li Hua's routine to complement his existing workouts. Specifically, Jennifer suggested incorporating yoga and dynamic stretching techniques into Li Hua's regimen. This approach aims to improve flexibility and balance, which would enhance Li Hua's overall fitness goals. Jennifer proposed starting these new sessions with a few sessions next week, specifically focusing on flexibility after Li Hua's strength training sessions on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Li Hua was enthusiastic about the plan and expressed his eagerness to start the new routine, indicating that Jennifer's suggestions were well-received and aligned with Li Hua's fitness objectives.
